svg.title: Groundskeeper — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as groundskeeper, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A long-handled four-tooth grounds rake sits beside a small distinct tuft of maintained grass. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
